Advertisement for the Position of Junior Research Fellow
Online applications are invited from interested and eligible candidates for the position of Junior Research
Fellow (JRF) under the project titled “Restoration of Phagosomal Defenses via PI3K–NOX Signaling
Reactivation for Host-Directed Control of Mycobacterial Infection”, sanctioned under the Prime
Minister Early Career Research Grant, sponsored by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation
(ANRF), Government of India.
The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the duration of the project or till the continuation
of the grant, whichever is earlier.
Interested candidates are required to submit their Letter of Interest and Curriculum Vitae (CV) through
email to amagray@uok.edu.in on or before 05th July 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about
the date of interview.

Educational Qualification: M.Sc. in Zoology with a
minimum of 55% marks, along with
NET/SET/SLET/GATE qualification.
Desirable: Candidates with hands-on research
experience in infection biology, molecular biology,
microbiology, zebrafish handling, animal models,
microscopy, CRISPR/Cas9, or related experimental
techniques will be given preference.
Candidates must produce original certificates and marksheets indicating academic qualifications and
percentage of marks, proof of age, NET/SET/SLET/GATE qualification certificate, and documents
evidencing research experience in the relevant field, if any, at the time of interview.
Please note that no TA/DA shall be admissible for appearing in the interview.
